First, we move all the terms to the left side of the inequality and factor:

$$
\begin{aligned}5x\cdot {3}^{x+1}+{3}^{x+1} & \ge -6\cdot {3}^{x+1} \\ 5x\cdot {3}^{x+1}+6\cdot {3}^{x+1}+{3}^{x+1} & \ge 0 \\ (5x+6+1){3}^{x+1} & \ge 0 \\ (5x+7){3}^{x+1} & \ge 0\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we divide both sides by ${3}^{x+1}$ and solve the resulting inequality using familiar techniques:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{(5x+7){3}^{x+1}}{{3}^{x+1}} & <\frac{0}{{3}^{x+1}} \\ 5x+7 & \ge 0 \\ 5x & \ge 0-7 \\ x & \ge -\frac{7}{5}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution to the inequality above is $x\ge -\frac{7}{5}.$
